limits: Two QSPI chips are board storage, not 32 MiB of on-die Flash.
Configuration bitstream, dual-quad mode and firmware partitions reduce available model space.
Do not assume the second Flash is entirely free or exposed as contiguous CPU memory.
The current hgb default DDR address window is 512 MiB; physical capacity is 1 GiB.
Xilinx DSP48/BRAM/LUT and Intel ALM counts are not Pango implementation results.
P1 synthesis counts do not establish the latest integrated system's physical resource margin.
